nativeValidation.setup: Use a clean checkout with the worker commit and the Node.js version from .nvmrc. Use macOS with Xcode tools, CMake, Ninja, jq, and a native Rust toolchain. Run commands in one Bash session from the checkout root. Copy the probe to files.copyTo after creating that directory. The script runs unsigned local packaging with a fresh Cargo target and uses the existing CEF cache without changing its notice files.
expectedResults: Record the actual checkout SHA. The original worker commit is 932e8b9d83bc671c0df0ea7db82d0e8a1a935965.
All four macOS wrapper scenarios pass. The Linux-only wrapper scenarios skip on macOS.
The app-only build and the app in the mounted DMG contain the embedded framework and both notices at Contents/Resources/cef. Each notice matches its original bytes.
A direct CEF_PATH with unpacked notices packages both files. The custom resource is present and the custom hook runs after staging in its configured cwd.
A corrupt archive, a missing archive, and missing credits each cause a nonzero exit with the relevant input in the diagnostic. The caller hook does not run and no new app is produced.

Shared CEF packaging succeeds with the notices removed from its CEF_PATH. The custom resource and hook work. The app omits the framework and CEF notices. Temporary notice staging is empty after the checks.
